title: To yoke me as his yokefellow
html_source: Stephen’s challenging himself asking if he will follow the nationalism of Griffiths and AE. He’s truly returned from the shifting sands of the strand and his thoughts are bound to Ireland’s contemporary zeitgeist : rebellion.
